title: [GMCP 203.048.06] Operations and evidence: Independent GMCP qualification and continuously complete release gate
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-048-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: One hermetic qualification command reconstructs the requirements ledger, builds clean artifacts, runs unit/integration/conformance/extension/interop/security/fuzz/platform/performance/recovery/doc tests, verifies evidence provenance, and emits a signed human-readable scorecard. Release is allowed only with 100% applicable requirements traced and passing, zero unexplained compatibility gaps, zero unresolved critical/high security findings and every VC-203 mastery gate green; new standards or accepted metrics automatically reopen qualification until classified. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
